title: 高松宮記念の後に・才能の証明

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What an electrifying experience! And the racer who sprinted past the rest is…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: King Halo! That's right, King Halo has snatched away first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's hard to tell whether everyone's surprised or overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But today's result is proof…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I really do have talent! Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You've done well too… improving my skills and helping me shine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's why we've managed to command all this attention today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Everyone's eyes are on King and her trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I return to the waiting room with King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King, King! Kiiiiing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Kawakami. You came.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd be great out there! You dashed through the last stretch just like Princess Fighter in episode thirty-two!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling so excited… I'm going to win the Takamatsunomiya Kinen one day too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Oh, Kawakami, you dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I may be your idol, but you don't have to chase after me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You have to find whatever it is that you want to do and then become first-rate at that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: At any rate, I think it's time we chose our next goal.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, looking at our current situation… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I could face off against Special Week and Seiun Sky in the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Also, Grass has announced her intention to run in the Takarazuka Kinen. El Condor Pasa may participate too, seeing as she wants to make it overseas.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Both choices will set me up in competition against my rivals.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, things will be exciting either way. But on the other hand…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As the leading star, I don't necessarily need the presence of a rival to shine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: On top of that, it seems like there isn't enough excitement for the mile races this summer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should help everyone by running in this year's Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen is a 1,600-meter turf mile race, a bit longer than the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
choice_data_list: What do you want to do?
What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, I thought that was obvious.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm going to take the throne as King of the Mile—a fitting name for a dazzling Umamusume such as myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Besides, we have massive potential to rise far beyond our current achievements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our next goal for the Yasuda Kinen.
